edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Subject to final agreement and client approval, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 40,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within 30 calendar days after both parties execute this Agreement.

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the matters described in the pleadings through the date of this Agreement. This release does not cover obligations under this Agreement or claims that cannot lawfully be released.

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY.
